results.title: Morton Meet the Eye
results.overview: An amateur sleuth named Morton attempts to uncover the identity of a legendary detective known as “The Eye” during a chaotic and deadly Hollywood luncheon

results.title: Good Girls
results.overview: In a correctional centre for girls, teens are kept safe from society and themselves, getting reprogrammed to become good female citizens in today’s Poland. But what does it take to become a “good girl”? And is that even something they want?

results.title: Free Flow
results.overview: The story follows a young boy, Paelo, who spends his semestral  break in his home in Laguna. During his stay, an event in his  family unfolds and he’ll be forced to navigate his surroundings  through a child’s imagination–with his favorite Auntie, Mae.

results.title: Teaching Practice: Idiot Girls and School Ghost 2
results.overview: Student teacher Kang Eun-kyung encounters a group of girls in a black magic club who are topping the national mock exams.

results.title: Whispers Next Door
results.overview: Suzanne hides her daughter’s shocking secret to protect their family, but when their charismatic Pastor takes a disturbing interest in the baby, their lies ignite a chilling battle between faith, control, and truth.

results.title: No One Leaves
results.overview: Six friends gather to celebrate a birthday in a cabin far from the city. What begins as a night of laughter, alcohol, and substances slowly spirals into something darker, as the boundaries of reality start to collapse. When events take an unexpected turn, the group is forced to question whether what they are experiencing is real… or only in their minds.

results.title: Foreplay
results.overview: Hosted by your favorite hot babe Sheree Bautista, Foreplay is a Valentine’s Special that explores the art of seduction before desire turns physical. Featuring 10 curated VMX films, this sensual guide dives into flirting, teasing, and giving in to passion.

results.title: Jean
results.overview: Over the course of eight years, the film draws an intimate portrait of Jean Ciesielski, a teenager growing up in Antwerp. Moving through a succession of schools and educational tracks, Jean searches for a place within a system that has defined him from a young age. At twelve years old, he speaks about his situation with a striking maturity and clarity. As he gets older, Jean feels an increasing urgency for change. Unable to obtain a regular secondary school diploma within his current track, he decides to change schools once more. His journey reveals how strongly the language and expectations of education have shaped the way he sees himself and his place in society.

results.title: Holy Defiance
results.overview: Since 2024, on central squares in many towns and cities across Croatia, groups of primarily elderly and middle-aged men calling themselves 'The Knights of the Immaculate Heart of Mary', gather together in communal prayer and advocating for Christian values, the importance of the patriarchy and enforcing limitations of women's rights, treating these squares as their own personal battlefield, upon which women have no place. Through the documentations of the reactions of law enforcement officials, ordinary passerbys and the 'Knights' themselves, as well as the defiant pieces of multimedia artist Arijana Lekić, Holy Defiance creates a vivid, lively, energetic and varied portrait of women's rights in post-war Croatia.

results.title: Beau Ideal
results.overview: In the stillness of a remote town, a troubled writer intervenes in a neighbor’s abusive household— testing the limits of truth, heroism and his own fractured sense of self.

results.title: The Worm's-Eye View of the Bird
results.original_title: The Worm's-Eye View of the Bird
results.overview: A girl falls in love with a worm - who winds up breaking her heart.

results.title: Perfect
results.overview: During the worst drought on record, a wealthy pregnant woman living out an escapist fantasy falls in love with a younger woman starting her life over.

results.title: Zoo Break Out
results.overview: A failed experiment causes four aggressive animals to escape a zoo and converge on a remote cabin, where a grieving woman and her friends must fight to survive as tensions and morality unravel.

results.title: Bhartha Mahasayulaku Wignyapthi
results.overview: What begins as a casual fling between a married man, Ram a.k.a Satya and Manasa in the middle of an international business trip, balloons into an out-of-the-blue mess when the latter lands in Hyderabad, disrupting Ram’s otherwise stable marriage with Balamani.

results.title: Á Huldu - The Hidden Ones
results.overview: In the Icelandic countryside, a news cameraman is found dead under unsettling circumstances, his reporter colleague has vanished without a trace.  The mystery remains unsolved.  Years later, a documentary crew retraces the investigation, piecing together fragments of testimony, archival material, and newly uncovered footage. What begins as a cold case review becomes something more elusive as new evidence reveals hidden connections and unanswered questions.  Á Huldu – The Hidden Ones is an 85-minute English and Icelandic-language feature that adopts a true-crime documentary framework to explore the instability of truth, the ethics of observation, and the persistence of unresolved narratives.

results.title: The Absurd Story of Gialappa’s Band
results.overview: Forty years after their beginnings on the frequencies of Radio Popolare, Gialappa’s Band retraces its professional history in a film directed by Walter Veltroni.With his attentive and original perspective, the director takes us through four decades of comedy, invention, and irony, recounting the journey of Giorgio Gherarducci, Marco Santin, and Carlo Taranto, three leading figures who revolutionized the language of entertainment in Italy. L’assurda storia della Gialappa’s Band explores the creative universe of the legendary trio and the mark left by their unique brand of comedy, capable of transcending generations and becoming an integral part of Italian popular culture.

results.title: Next Life
results.overview: Ivy finds herself confronted with parallel universes in which her life unspools in very different ways set against the modern London jazz scene.

results.title: Carnal Inferno
results.overview: The tale of Mark Benway, a boxer who takes a punch that sends him into a world no man wants to go and one that he may never leave.
